title: Quitting music in 1946 for the church
summary: Trotter stopped playing in 1946 because he thought it a sin; he devoted himself to the church and its trustee board.

story.theme_name: Church, faith and religion in a musician's life
story.community_name: Church, faith and jazz: the sacred and the secular
